jamie: 2026-03-10 12:05 UTC — perf alert: hosted-pool-west-1 redwood-mini-v2 p99 jumped from ~380ms to ~2.1s, qps down ~28%. perf-monitor fired. grafana: https://grafana.company/d/xyz
lina: copying graphs. any kernel_select logs for 12:00-12:10? suspect scheduler/autotuner interaction
akshay: pulled an end-to-end trace from one canary pod, snippet:
```
[12:03:12.105] admission: microbatch_size=1 -> grow_to=4 (reason=heuristic)
[12:03:12.110] kernel_select: prefer=fast_attn (score=9.2) -> selected=generic_attn (score=13.8)
[12:03:12.116] kvcache: size=22MB hit=0.83 evict/sec=0.005
[12:03:12.119] memcpy_path: busy (2.9ms)
[12:03:12.125] request complete latency=1870ms
```
maria: that kernel_select change looks like the autotuner bumped generic kernel preference. PR-4056 touched the fp16 scoring and microbatch penalty
lina: confirmed PR-4056 rollout started at 12:02 UTC (canary). correlates
akshay: i toggled the autotuner off on one canary node at 12:12 and p99 reverted to ~390ms within 90s
jamie: immediate actions: pause PR-4056 rollout for remaining canaries, pin cost-model to 2026-03-08 for hosted-pool-west-1. oncall notified @oncall :warning:
maria: longer term: add a guardrail in scheduler to prevent microbatch growth if >3% of requests in 30s pick fallback_generic kernel. also add a metric for memcpy stall time
lina: test plan: run controlled perf sweep with microbatch sizes [1,2,4] + synthetic KV pressure (kvcache tool) on canary; collect kernel selection logs and top flamegraphs
akshay: creating PERF-1199 with repro details + raw traces uploaded: s3://perf-traces/2026-03-10/1776543210
perf-monitor: rollback scheduled for canary group at 12:15 UTC
jamie: assigning: akshay -> repro runs, lina -> kvcache histograms & admission traces, maria -> scheduler guardrail design, jamie -> coord + watch dashboards
lina: noted. i'll also add an alert rule to surface memcpy latency spikes (>1ms median per-second)
akshay: starting repro run now (12:18) on canary-2
jamie: keep updates short here, post logs to PERF-1199 ticket. thanks :eyes:
